switch_source: https://github.com/WashU-Astroparticle-Lab/daq/issues/69; Presto 2.17.1 recommended_dac_config scan at 5 MHz spacing, as reported in issue and repository plotting script
policy: Interpolate dBm linearly between adjacent calibration curves throughout each configured band, including DAC-switch uncertainty windows and measured level jumps. Switch-scan metadata and maximum_adjacent_jump_db are retained only as historical diagnostic context; they do not exclude intervals. Interpolated transitions are estimates, not resolved hardware steps.
configuration_limit: Actual DAC configurations and API version were not logged per October point. Single-port automatic Mixed configuration is assumed from the source notebook. Different configurations, output ports, DAC currents, nonzero IF, or shared-tile multiport operation require separate validation.
reference_plane: Estimated unfiltered SM200C analyzer-input power through the measurement cable path; 0.1–2.1 GHz calculated by filter offset; no cable-loss correction
measurement: 0.1–2.1 GHz: all 5050 original two-filter readings shifted by per-frequency offsets from direct unfiltered A=0.1 anchors. Offset uses log-amplitude interpolation of the original filtered curve at A=0.1. Above 2.1 GHz: direct unfiltered sweeps. Corrected low powers are estimates, not direct unfiltered observations.
low_band_correction: Constant dB offset across amplitudes at each frequency. Includes possible cross-session drift/path changes. Three negative offsets are retained and flagged, not clamped. Five same-day filter-pair comparisons are independent context, not the correction input.
